content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my personal task list","i_want":"to delete a task after confirming the deletion","so_that":"I can remove tasks I no longer need without deleting them by accident","business_description":"Users can remove a task from their task list. A deletion only goes ahead after the user confirms it in a prompt. The user sees a success or error message after the deletion attempt, and the list only changes once the backend confirms the deletion.","business_value":"Keeps the task list current and reduces accidental loss of tasks through the confirmation step.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"A task is shown in the task list","when":"The user chooses the delete action for that task","then":"A confirmation prompt is shown and the task is still shown in the list with no delete request sent yet"},{"given":"The confirmation prompt is shown for a task","when":"The user cancels the prompt","then":"No delete request is sent and the task remains unchanged in the list"},{"given":"The confirmation prompt is shown for an existing task","when":"The user confirms the deletion and the backend returns a success response","then":"The task is removed from the list and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"The user has confirmed the deletion and the delete request is still in progress","when":"The user views the task list","then":"The task still appears in the list because the frontend does not remove it before the backend confirms the deletion"},{"given":"The user has confirmed the deletion of a task","when":"The backend returns an error response","then":"The task remains in the list and an error message is displayed instead of a success message"},{"given":"A delete request is sent for a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"The backend processes the request","then":"The backend returns a task not found error and no task data is database errors and does not remove the task in that case.","The frontend shows the confirmation prompt before any delete request is sent.","The frontend removes the task from the list only after the
